title: Task Management Application
shortDescription: Full-stack task management platform with real-time tracking, role-based access control, and interactive productivity dashboards.
fullDescription: A comprehensive full-stack task management platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Enables real-time task tracking and team collaboration with a clean, intuitive interface. Features role-based access control (RBAC) to manage multi-user workflows securely, and interactive dashboards powered by Chart.js for visualizing team productivity, task completion rates, and workload distribution.
features: Real-time task tracking and team collaboration
Role-based access control (RBAC) for multi-user workflows
Secure REST APIs with JWT authentication
Interactive productivity dashboards with Chart.js
Task completion rate and workload distribution charts
Sprint-style task management
challenges: Designing a flexible RBAC system that scales across multiple team structures
Building performant real-time dashboards with complex aggregations
Optimizing MongoDB queries for large task datasets

title: Heavy Vehicle Management System
shortDescription: Full-stack logistics platform with real-time vehicle tracking, load request management, route optimization, and a mobile app for drivers.
fullDescription: A complete logistics management platform designed for tracking heavy vehicles in real time. Built with Angular for the web dashboard and Angular Native for mobile, enabling drivers and managers to access tracking and logistics features on the go. The FastAPI backend with MySQL handles transactional data efficiently, while third-party GPS APIs power live location updates. Features include load request management, route optimization, and a mobile-first experience for field operations.
features: Real-time vehicle tracking via GPS APIs
Load request management and route optimization
Mobile application for drivers and managers
Transactional data management with MySQL
Role-based dashboard for fleet managers
Live location updates and trip history
challenges: Integrating third-party GPS APIs for reliable real-time tracking
Building a performant mobile app with Angular Native for logistics use cases
Designing MySQL schemas for complex transactional logistics data

title: Data Analytics & Visualization Platform
shortDescription: Full-stack analytics platform with interactive public dashboards, real-time charts, custom filters, and automated CI/CD deployment.
fullDescription: A comprehensive data analytics and visualization platform built with Angular and FastAPI. Features an interactive public dashboard with real-time charts built using ApexCharts, Chart.js, and ECharts. Organizations can securely input data which is instantly reflected on the public visualization dashboard with live data refresh. Deployed on Apache with automated CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high availability and zero-downtime cloud deployments.
features: Interactive public dashboard with real-time charts
Custom filters and data export capabilities
Secure organizational data input with live visualization
Real-time data refresh and live updates
Multiple chart types: ApexCharts, Chart.js, ECharts
Automated CI/CD deployment on Apache for zero downtime
challenges: Ensuring real-time data sync between input forms and public dashboards
Combining multiple charting libraries (ApexCharts, Chart.js, ECharts) into a unified UX
Setting up zero-downtime CI/CD deployments on Apache

title: Enterprise MERN & Angular Applications
shortDescription: Delivered 7+ full-stack enterprise web applications using MERN stack and Angular for multiple clients at Oges Solutions.
fullDescription: Over the course of my tenure at Oges Solutions, I designed and delivered 7+ full-stack web applications for various enterprise clients. These applications were built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) and Angular, covering diverse domains including business management, reporting systems, and client portals. Each application featured secure JWT authentication, optimized MySQL/MongoDB databases, AWS cloud deployments, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
features: 7+ production-grade full-stack applications
Secure JWT authentication and authorization
AWS (EC2, S3) cloud deployments with performance optimization
Optimized MySQL and MongoDB databases with indexing strategies
CI/CD pipeline integration for automated deployments
Responsive, accessible UI across all platforms
challenges: Managing multiple concurrent client projects with different tech requirements
Ensuring security best practices across varied production environments
Optimizing database queries for high-traffic enterprise applications

title: Elasticsearch Full-Text Search System
shortDescription: Scalable, high-speed full-text search system built with Elasticsearch, enabling fast querying across large datasets at Taxmann Technologies.
fullDescription: Designed and implemented an Elasticsearch-based full-text search system for enterprise products at Taxmann Technologies. The system enables scalable, high-speed querying across large datasets, dramatically reducing search response times. The implementation included index design, query optimization, and integration with the existing Node.js and FastAPI backends, supporting complex data workflows across multiple product integrations.
features: Full-text search across large enterprise datasets
Optimized Elasticsearch index design and query tuning
Scalable search supporting complex data workflows
Significant reduction in search response times
Integration with Node.js and FastAPI backends
Support for multiple product integrations
challenges: Designing Elasticsearch indices for complex, multi-domain enterprise data
Tuning search relevance and ranking for legal/tax content
Integrating Elasticsearch with existing microservices without downtime
